 "rationale": "The classic PNP/NMOS-level-shift bandgap cannot work at 1.62 V. The PMOS diode would sit at VDD-|Vsg|, about 0.47 V at ss/-40 C, which is below the PNP emitters (about 0.82 V). A subthreshold beta-multiplier keeps its NMOS sources near ground and gives a PTAT current. The output Veb (about 0.68 V) plus about 0.2 V PTAT gives about 0.88 V, with a slope near -0.85 mV/C (about 1000 ppm/C). There are 3 branches at 0.5 uA plus 0.2 uA start-up, so power is about 3.4 uW at 1.98 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":      (0.5e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.8e-6),   # per-branch PTAT current
    "K":      (8, 4, 16),                  # beta-multiplier W ratio
    "gmid_n": (22, 16, 26),                # NMOS pair deep moderate/weak inversion
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_p": (10, 7, 14),                 # PMOS mirror
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "vptat":  (0.20, 0.12, 0.26),          # I*R2 PTAT add-on at 27 C
    "Cf":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 3e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd filter cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = int(round(p["K"])); Ln = p["Ln"]; Lp = p["Lp"]

    # NMOS beta-multiplier: M1 diode (W1), M2 = K*W1 degenerated by R1
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], Ln, I, vds=0.5)
    W1 = max(m1.W, 0.42)
    W2 = K * W1

    # find vgs of M2 carrying I (bisection on forward model), vsb ~ dVgs
    def id_at(vgs, vsb):
        return lut.op("n", W2, Ln, vgs, 0.45, vsb)["Id"]
    vsb = 0.06
    for _ in range(3):
        lo, hi = 0.0, m1.vgs
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if id_at(mid, vsb) > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        dv = max(m1.vgs - vgs2, 0.02)
        vsb = dv
    R1 = dv / I
    R2 = p["vptat"] / I

    # PMOS mirror (same L, gm/Id, current) for core branches and output
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I, vds=1.0)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.M("M1", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, Ln)
    n.M("M2", "nb", "na", "ns", "vss", "nfet", W2, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "ns", "vss", R1)
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("CF", "nb", "vdd", p["Cf"])
    # output: Vref = Veb + I*R2
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "ve", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "ve", m=1)

    # start-up: weak pull-up on sx; vref high pulls sx low; sx high sinks current from nb
    n.M("MSP1", "sp", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MSP2", "sx", "vss", "sp", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4.0, 0.5)
    n.M("MS", "nb", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)

    # predictions
    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / I)
    vref = veb + p["vptat"]
    slope = (-1.7e-3 + 0.15e-3) + p["vptat"] / 300.0     # V/C
    tc_ppm = abs(slope) * 1e6 / vref
    i_start = 0.2e-6
    power = 1.98 * (3 * I + i_start)
    gds_tot = mp.gds
    rout = 1.0 / max(gds_tot, 1e-12)
    # supply -> vref via PMOS gds into (R2 + 1/gm_pnp)
    rload = R2 + UT / I
    line_reg = rload / (rload + rout) * 3.0
    psrr = -db(max(line_reg, 1e-4))
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc_ppm, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
